resources.string: Pair a trusted computer to control this phone
Only pair a computer you trust. While control is on, the paired computer can read your screen and send taps and text on this phone. Stop it any time below.
Paste the pairing text from “android-use pair”
Not paired yet. Paste the pairing text above to begin.
That pairing text is incomplete. Copy the full block from the terminal and paste it again.
Save a pairing first, then start.
Control is on. Keep this phone and the paired computer on the same Wi-Fi. Turn on Accessibility in Settings if the app was not installed over ADB.
Control stopped. If you installed the app by hand, also turn the service off in Accessibility settings.
